run_all_tests_command.command_line: ./gradlew test; _EC=$?; python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, glob; root=ET.Element('testsuites'); [root.append(ET.parse(f).getroot()) for f in glob.glob('build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml')]; ET.ElementTree(root).write('{tests_report_file}', xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')"; exit $_EC

run_specified_tests_command.command_line: ./gradlew test $(python3 -c "import sys; files='{tests_list}'.split(); print(' '.join(['--tests '+f.replace('src/test/kotlin/','').replace('.kt','').replace('/','.')  for f in files])"); _EC=$?; python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, glob; root=ET.Element('testsuites'); [root.append(ET.parse(f).getroot()) for f in glob.glob('build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml')]; ET.ElementTree(root).write('{tests_report_file}', xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')"; exit $_EC

run_all_tests_with_coverage_command.command_line: ./gradlew test; _EC=$?; python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, glob; root=ET.Element('testsuites'); [root.append(ET.parse(f).getroot()) for f in glob.glob('build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml')]; ET.ElementTree(root).write('{tests_report_file}', xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')"; python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; tree=ET.parse('build/reports/jacoco/test/jacocoTestReport.xml'); root=tree.getroot(); lines=[]; [lines.extend(['SF:src/main/kotlin/'+pkg.get('name')+'/'+sf.get('name')]+['DA:'+l.get('nr')+','+l.get('ci','0') for l in sf.findall('line')]+['end_of_record']) for pkg in root.findall('package') for sf in pkg.findall('sourcefile')]; open('{tests_coverage_report_file}','w').write('\n'.join(lines))"; exit $_EC
